vb_textbox.text: When the game first started, I went for the smaller of the two gnomes. If both were small, then I would look in the middle of the screen and pick the brightest of the two. If both were large I would pick the dullest of the two. This seemed to work for a little while but then I started to pick randomly. At the end I would always try to pick the tall purple capped gnome and the small green capped gnome as they both seemed to provide a good amount of mushrooms. In my opinion, you should just go with your gut and see if you can come up with any theories of what to pick yourself.
